author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
We are back at it with our Rings of Power watch parties!  Join me LIVE as we watch and react together, followed by some deeper conversation as I take questions/comments from the live chat!

HOW IT WORKS:
1) Pull up Rings of Power on your Prime Video account on your tv, computer screen, or whatever device you want to watch on.
2) Use a second screen, phone, tablet, or whatever to pull up this stream.
3) We all start playing the episodes at the same time, watching together, then discussing afterwards

#ringsofpower #lordoftherings #watchparty
title: Rings of Power Season 3 Premiere Watch Party
